meta.topic: Space emission systems (terminal units) configuration reference
architecture: Emission is configured on TWO levels that cooperate.

Level 1 - 'HeatingSystemCalculator' emission keys (flat keys of the HVAC input dict): choose the terminal TYPE (Radiator / Floor heating / Fan coil via the TB14 table), the hydraulic circuit topology (C.2-C.5), the flow-temperature control and the hydraulic limits. Heating only.

Level 2 - 'EmissionSystemCalculator' (EN 15316-2:2017, hourly): does not know terminal names; it is parametric (equivalent temperature effects in K, embedded-emitter losses, fan/control electricity). Heating AND cooling. It can run standalone or be plugged into Level 1 with emission_calculation_mode='en15316-2' + emission_15316_2_config.

In 'simplified' mode losses come from emission_efficiency and auxiliars_power. In 'en15316-2' mode losses/auxiliaries come from the K-based EN 15316-2 result, while emitter_type/TB14 still drive the hydraulics (nominal delta-T, exponent, nominal flow).

Downstream link: Q_H_em_in_kWh / QH_em_i_in is the demand passed to distribution (EN 15316-3); W_*_em_aux_kWh is an electric load that can be added to E_site_el_load_kWh for the PV calculator (see pv_system_configuration_reference.json).
notes: Every key is optional (cfg.get with a default) unless marked required.

The code does not enforce the '>= 0' limits stated in examples/new_building_input_en.md for the K contributions: only fan_power_W/control_power_W/fan_count/control_count are clipped at 0 and convective_fraction at [0, 1]. Negative K values are legitimate (the repo's fan-coil example uses room_automation_K = -0.5).

emitter_types._source: TB14 default table (pybuildingenergy.global_inputs.TB14). Passing a DataFrame under the key 'TB14' replaces it: emitter_type then accepts exactly the index labels of that table.

_table_columns.Emitters_nominale_deltaTeta_air_C: Nominal emitter-to-air temperature difference (K). Note: 'nominale' is the spelling used in the code.
_table_columns.Emitters_exponent_n: Emission exponent n: delta-T_air_eff = delta-T_air * (Phi_eff / Phi_nominal)^(1/n)
_table_columns.Emitters_nominal_deltaTeta_Water_C: Nominal water supply-return difference (K). Nominal flow V_nom [m3/h] = nominal_power[kW] / (delta-T_water * 1.16)

Radiator.meaning: Convective/radiative wall radiator: high water-to-air difference, strongly non-linear emission.

Floor heating.meaning: Radiant floor: low supply temperature, small delta-T, near-linear emission.

Fan coil.meaning: Forced-convection terminal: fast response, electric fan auxiliaries (set auxiliars_power / fan_power_W).

emitter_types.unknown_type_handling: check_heating_system_inputs() replaces an emitter_type that is not in the TB14 index with the first row of the table and reports a message. HeatingSystemCalculator itself raises KeyError on an unknown label.

level_1_heating_system_emission_keys.usage: pybuildingenergy.HeatingSystemCalculator(hvac_dict).compute_step(QH_kWh, T_internal_C, T_external_C); validate first with pybuildingenergy.check_heating_system_inputs(hvac_dict). These keys sit in the same flat dict as the distribution and generation keys.

allowed: (any index label of a custom TB14)

nominal_power.description: Nominal emission power of the terminal(s). Keep coherent with emission_15316_2_config.heating.nominal_power_kW.

auxiliars_power.description: Terminal electric power (fans, actuators). IMPORTANT: in 'simplified' mode it only reduces the heat input by the recovered share (ON time * load factor * P / 1000 * auxiliary_recovery_factor); the electricity itself is NOT reported (W_H_em_aux(kWh) is always 0). To obtain terminal electricity use emission_calculation_mode='en15316-2' with fan_power_W/fan_count/control_power_W/control_count.

auxiliary_recovery_factor.description: Share of the auxiliary electricity that is recovered as heat (subtracted from the emission input).

mixing_valve.description: true: the minimum emitter supply temperature is raised by mixing_valve_delta and the distribution/emission side follows the emitter supply temperature (mixed secondary circuit); false: no offset, the circuit follows the node (primary) supply temperature.

mixing_valve_delta.description: Temperature offset added to the minimum emitter supply temperature.

selected_emm_cont_circuit.description: Hydraulic behaviour of the emission circuit (EN 15316-1 annex circuit types). Any other value raises ValueError.

values.0: C.2 - CONSTANT mass flow rate and VARIABLE temperature; supply/return derived from the power balance.
values.1: C.3 - VARYING mass flow, CONSTANT emitter temperature; return temperature limited, flow adapts to meet the power. Reads: Max flow temperature, Max delta-T flow/return, Desired return temperature.
values.2: C.4 - INTERMITTENT flow (ON-OFF control): evaluates the ON-power and a duty cycle to meet the hourly energy. Reads: Desired load factor with ON-OFF.
values.3: C.5 - CONSTANT mass flow with VARIABLE heat exchange (bypass behaviour). Reads: Minimum flow temperature, Desired load factor.

description.Type 1 - Based on demand: Supply temperature = minimum required by the current emission demand.
description.Type 2 - Based on outdoor temperature: Weather-compensated curve from outdoor_temp_data (interpolated between min/max outdoor and min/max supply).

flow_temp_control_type.note: Any other string silently behaves like Type 2.

constant_flow_temp.description: Only the first element is used.

heat_emission_data.description: Hydraulic limits/setpoints of the emission circuit. The code reads each cell as .loc[row_label, column_label], so both the labels below are required.

cells.row: Desired load factor with ON-OFF for HZ1

outdoor_temp_data.description: Weather-compensation curve of the secondary supply temperature.

emission_calculation_mode.description: Any value that is not one of the en15316-2 aliases falls back to 'simplified'.

TB14.description: Custom terminal table (same three columns as the default).

level_1_heating_system_emission_keys.verified_combinations: All 3 emitter types x 4 circuits (0-3) x 3 flow_temp_control_types = 36 combinations execute without error.

demand_unit.description: Unit of the raw Q_H/Q_C columns (columns already named *_kWh are kWh).

cooling_solar_gain_temperature_C.description: Added to the outdoor temperature to form the combined external temperature in cooling.

default_heating_internal_temperature_C.description: Used when the input has no internal-temperature column.

per_service_blocks._note: Both blocks share the same keys. The temperature increase applied is the SUM of the five effects (plus the two intermittent effects when enabled); embedded_K is NOT part of that sum.

room_automation_K.description: Room automation effect (negative values reduce the increase).

include_intermittent_in_hourly.description: true adds intermittent_control_K and intermittent_emitter_K to the temperature increase.

embedded_K.description: Embedded-emitter losses (floor/ceiling/wall panels): Q_emb_ls = Q_inc * embedded_K / |delta-T between equivalent internal and external temperature|.

nominal_power_kW.description: Caps the recalculated output at nominal_power_kW * hours.

convective_fraction.description: Convective share of the emission; reported as fH_em_conv / fC_em_conv.

calculation: delta = sum of the K effects; heating: T_inc = T_int_ini + delta ; cooling: T_inc = T_int_ini - delta
Q_out_inc = Q_out * (T_inc - T_ext_comb) / (T_int_ini - T_ext_comb)  (or the user-supplied Q_*_em_out_inc_kWh column)
Q_em_ls = (Q_out_inc - Q_out) + Q_emb_ls ; Q_em_in = Q_out + Q_em_ls

_custom_TB14_example._how_to_use: Convert to a DataFrame (index = type name) and pass it under the HVAC key 'TB14'; then emitter_type: 'Ceiling radiant panel' is valid. The numbers above are illustrative, not from a standard.

floor_heating_simplified.description: Radiant floor, weather-compensated, constant-flow circuit C.2, simplified losses.

radiator_on_off_circuit.description: Radiators, ON-OFF intermittent circuit C.4, demand-driven supply temperature.

fan_coil_constant_temperature_with_auxil.description: Fan coils on constant 45 degC supply, circuit C.5. Note: in simplified mode the 60 W only reduces the heat input (recovered share); no electricity is reported. Use the en15316-2 fan-coil example below to get W_H_em_aux.

floor_heating_en15316_2_neutral.description: Floor heating with the hourly EN 15316-2 model, all equivalent-temperature effects set to zero (structure taken from get_example_hvac_input()). Replace the zeros with the EN 15316-2 Annex B values that apply to your terminal/control (the code ships no per-terminal K table).

fan_coil_en15316_2_heating_cooling.description: Water fan coils with PI room control, balanced hydraulics and stand-alone room automation; K values, fans and controls copied from emission_system_config() in examples/heat_pump_15316_4_2_example.py (documented there as EN 15316-2:2017 Annex B defaults).

radiator_en15316_2_with_intermittent_eff.description: Radiators with intermittent-operation effects enabled. K values are ILLUSTRATIVE placeholders to show the keys, not standard values.

standalone_emission_system_calculator_he.description: EmissionSystemCalculator used on its own (no HeatingSystemCalculator), for a reversible fan-coil system.
